page.layout: One printed page, single text block. Top: printed title block, centred (work title). Below it: section number "I." and a centred sub-heading. Then numbered theses 1 and 2 in the body. Right margin: two marginal notes ("De regnorum origine" beside thesis 1, "molestiâ:" beside thesis 2). Foot: signature ")(" with page number "2".

main_text.head: ELIÆ REUSNERI LEORINI FLORUM HORTULI HISTORICO-POLITICI OECONOMIA.
CORONÆ IMPERATORIÆ FLORES
main_text.p: 1. Deo imperia: quorum ipse estDe regno-rum ori-gine Auctor: quod probant divina ejus opera: Matrimonii institutio: Terræ dominium hominibus traditum: Politia Judaica legib. ab ipsomet fundata: Parva magnorum imperiorum incunabula: Conservator: utpote qui Principes nonnullos heroico armat spiritu: Seditiosos & facinorosos mirabiliter ad supplicia rapit: Tyrannorum impetus sæpius frangit: Post bellatores plerumque togatos excitat Principes.
2. Regnum splendida servitus.molestiâ: Imperii onus esse maximum, illorum

page.notes: No marginal text other than the two right-hand notes. A decorative sign stands before "Deo" and before "Auctor" in thesis 1; it is not transcribed. The first thesis is set as a run of short clauses; lines are joined into one paragraph. Printed hyphens in the margin note are kept as "regno-rum ori-gine". Page ends mid-sentence ("illorum"), so the text continues on the next page. No running head is printed.
